title: userform
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

description.description: Type additional information to describe the form or dashboard, such as the filter criteria or intended audience.

formjson.description: Json representation of the form layout.

formxml.description: Shows the XML representation of the layout of the form or dashboard.

istabletenabled.description: Information that specifies whether the dashboard is enabled for tablet.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

name.description: Type a descriptive name for the form or dashboard.

objecttypecode.description: Shows the record type (entity) code that the form applies to.

userformid.description: Unique identifier of the user dashboard.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user or team who is assigned to manage the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Shows the business unit that the record owner belongs to.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the dashboard.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the dashboard.
